'''Sam Saddek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who served [[House Rist]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He and his brother, [[Kai Saddek]], threatened to divulge secrets once held between House Rist and the [[House of Thul]]. He engaged an Imperial spacer and was easily defeated.<ref name="TOR:TAS" />

==Biography==
{{GameDSmechanics}}
After being exiled from House Rist along with his brother, the pair attempted to blackmail House Thul using a list of various assassinations that Thul had hired Rist to carry out. However, the Imerpial sent to retrieve it easily overwhelmed the brothers. Disgusted with what his brother had become, Sam knocked him out and gave the Imperial the location of the evidence. Though he offered to take his brothers assassins and disappear, the Imperial still decided to kill him.<ref name="TOR:TAS" />
{{Endgame}}
